blurb: Imagine a long journey west in a Conestoga wagon, transporting corn to be ground at a nearby trade work. Your wagon approaches its destination - 1738 Herr’s Grist Mill. Mill Bridge Village & Camp Resort is home to this registered historic landmark. If you’ve ever dreamed of camping right next to a real-life working Amish Farm, there is no better place to do it than at Mill Bridge Village & Camp Resort!
